name: Darion Mograine
summary: Darion Mograine is the younger son of the fallen Highlord Alexandros Mograine, the legendary Ashbringer. A paladin who joined the Argent Dawn following his father's mysterious downfall, Darion's desperate quest to uncover his family's fate placed him at the center of the conflict consuming the Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Son of the Silver Hand
sections.body: Darion grew up in the shadow of his father's towering legacy. Raised near Brill in the kingdom of Lordaeron, he witnessed the onset of the plague of undeath and eventually took up arms as a recruit in the Knights of the Silver Hand during the Third War. After falling in battle at Stratholme and narrowly surviving, Darion's world unraveled when his father perished under suspicious circumstances. Struggling with grief and questioning his faith in the Holy Light, Darion chose a different road than the zealous Scarlet Crusade, ultimately throwing his lot in with the newly formed Argent Dawn.

sections.title: The Quest for the Ashbringer
sections.body: Questioning the Light after his father's death, Darion was confronted by the troll priest Zabra Hexx, who counseled him to seek out his father in a fortress floating above a burning city. That cryptic omen set Darion on a new path into the Argent Dawn, and it points him toward the dread necropolis Naxxramas, where he believes the truth behind Alexandros's fate lies hidden.

faq.answer: Darion is a human warrior and paladin of the Argent Dawn, and the younger son of Highlord Alexandros Mograine, the original wielder of the legendary Ashbringer blade.

faq.q: Why didn't Darion join the Scarlet Crusade like his brother?
faq.answer: While his elder brother Renault climbed the ranks of the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, Darion grew disillusioned with zealotry after their father's death. Guided by outside counsel and seeking genuine redemption rather than blind fury, Darion pledged his sword to the more inclusive Argent Dawn instead.

faq.q: What is Darion's connection to the Ashbringer?
faq.answer: As a youth, Darion secretly attended his father's meeting with the Silver Hand at an inn in Southshore, where he witnessed the purification of what would later become the heart of the Ashbringer, the blade his father made legendary.

angles.text: Darion represents the deep crisis of faith paladins faced following the fall of Lordaeron, struggling to balance duty to the Light with the grim realities of the Plaguelands.
The tragic splintering of the Mograine household mirrors the ruin of Lordaeron itself, dividing brothers into rival orders amid the kingdom's ashes.
